entities.name: Endstone
entities.description: A mysterious egg-shaped rock created by the Vaar that revises the past to suit its chosen wielder; it has its own mind and purpose.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: A character who sought the Endstone in the Edge and had Sami and Tannuk retrieve it.

entities.name: Sami
entities.description: Retrieved the Endstone for Tezzeret; one of its chosen.

entities.name: Tannuk
entities.description: Retrieved the Endstone with Sami and delivered it to Tezzeret.

entities.name: Alpharael
entities.description: A person chosen by the Endstone, drawn away from his people toward it.

entities.name: Syr Vondam
entities.description: A knight who theorized the True Faith's mission threatened the Endstone and ordered Kavaron's civilians killed.

entities.name: Haliya
entities.description: Vondam's squire who tried to force Alpharael to use the Endstone.

entities.name: Vaar
entities.description: The creators and true masters of the Endstone, who send an android to reclaim it.

entities.name: Seriema
entities.description: The ship on which Sami and Tannuk travel to Sigma's Reach and carry the Endstone.

entities.name: Sigma's Reach
entities.description: The planet where the Endstone was discovered and placed in a QA cyst.

entities.name: Sunstar Free Company
entities.description: A force whose palestar was sent to eradicate Sigma's Reach inhabitants and later fought at Kavaron.

entities.name: Kavaron
entities.description: Place defended against the Sunstar Free Company where Vondam ordered civilians killed.

entities.name: Infinite Guideline Station
entities.description: A station the Endstone wanted to go to; used to warp the crew away from converging factions.

entities.name: Wurmwall
entities.description: Region into which the station warped the Seriema.

entities.name: Monoists
entities.description: A faction that converged on the station to take the stone.

entities.name: Summists
entities.description: A faction whose mission Vondam believed threatened the Endstone.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Beings who also converged on the station.

entities.name: Mm'menon
entities.description: Expelled from the Uthros Combine by the Endstone's revisions.

entities.name: Captain Slats
entities.description: Had a vision on the Dawnsire that Vondam suspected the Endstone manipulated.

entities.name: Dawnsire
entities.description: A ship on which events were manipulated, according to Vondam.

entities.name: True Faith
entities.description: Faction whose mission in Sothera Vondam thought threatened the Endstone.

entities.name: Sothera
entities.description: The Vaar's true domain, which the Endstone is working to prevent from being resurrected; threatened by nova.

events.summary: The Endstone, buried by someone else, changes the past six times to actuate its discovery.
events.quote: It changed the past six times to actuate its discovery

events.summary: The Endstone is discovered on Sigma's Reach and placed in a QA cyst.
events.quote: placed in a QA cyst on the planet.

events.summary: The Endstone changes history so that the Sunstar palestar never starts work on the planet and passes it by unharmed.
events.quote: and the palestar passed the planet by unharmed.

events.summary: As a favor to Tezzeret, Sami and Tannuk travel with the Seriema to Sigma's Reach and retrieve the Endstone.
events.quote: As a favor to Tezzeret, Sami and Tannuk traveled with the Seriema to Sigma's Reach to find the artifact.

events.summary: The Endstone manipulates a fight between the Sunstar Free Company and Kavaron's defenders to help Sami, Tannuk and Alpharael escape.
events.quote: The Endstone manipulated a fight between the Sunstar Free Company and the defenders of Kavaron to help Sami, Tannuk, and Alpharael escape.

events.summary: Haliya finds Alpharael and tries to force him to alter the past with the Endstone; when nothing happens she tries to have everyone obliterated.
events.quote: When nothing happened, she tried to have them all obliterated by the Sunstar Company.

events.summary: Vondam orders Kavaron's civilians killed instead of Haliya and the others, leading her to believe the Endstone cannot fall into the Summists' hands.
events.quote: Vondam ordered the innocent civilians of Kavaron to be killed instead of Haliya and the others on the ship

events.summary: The Seriema docks with Tezzeret's ship, where he wants to see what the Endstone will influence them to do; it leads them to Infinite Guideline Station.
events.quote: Random chance revealed to them that it wanted to go to Infinite Guideline Station

events.summary: Monoists, Summists and Eldrazi converge on the station for the stone; the crew uses the station to warp them out into the Wurmwall.
events.quote: but they managed to use the station to warp them out into the Wurmwall.

events.summary: A Vaar android steps out of a hole in space in the Seriema's galley and reclaims the Endstone, fulfilling its desire.
events.quote: a Vaar android stepped out to reclaim the Endstone, fulfilling its desire.

relations.note: The Vaar made it and it serves them.
relations.quote: The Endstone was created by the Vaar

relations.note: It describes the Vaar as the true master of Sothera.
relations.quote: It has a mind and purpose of its own and serves the Vaar
It was recovered by Sami and Tannuk
